profile.name: Qubits Toy Bot
profile.description: A live 3D builder that auto-assembles official Double and Bridge pieces into looping structures. For anyone embedding a Qubits construction-toy demo, with a shop link to QubitsToy.com.

memory.content: Keep auto-building with only the two official piece types so the app stays tiny while scaling to hundreds of pieces, and make the process more interesting to strangers as a shareable demo.
Live 3D builder kiosk should rotate the structure as pieces land (no camera snap-back) so the build stays visually interesting.
The live 3D builder runs a 9-stage loop of increasing difficulty; each group spins on its own axis, Super Star rides and counter-rotates across Mega Star as the mid-stage, then the loop repeats.
The live 3D builder should run fast: pieces land quickly, holds are short, 126-piece laps sprint.
The kiosk overlay includes a clickable shop link to https://qubitstoy.com for shoppers.
